column3: MT 62:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. “Only toward God is my soul silent” is rendered “My soul waits in silence for God only.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my refuge” is rendered “My stronghold,” and “much” as “greatly.”
The Hebrew has “you will be murdered”; NASB renders “That you may murder him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in their inner being” is rendered “inwardly.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “rest,” and renders “my honor” as “my glory.”
“The children of humankind … the children of man” is rendered “Men of low degree … men of rank,” and “a breath” as “vanity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “if it bears fruit” is rendered “If riches increase.”
Close to the Hebrew; “strength” is rendered “power.”
